RVA-F-0177.question: What exact state does the direct normalized-index-one Great Wall branch write?

scope.boundary: This packet follows only the direct index-one branch through its pair-table writes. The producer and consumer semantics of the pair table, the neutral clock-like word, diplomacy decisions, user presentation, and runtime execution remain outside this packet.

dependencies.use: Binds item 201 to The Great Wall and its stored peace description.
Provides the direct mode-one city call, player argument, and normalized-index guard.
Independently identifies the special 0x830E8FE2 value-two gate on the index-one eligibility path.

staticBranch.gate: At 0x82D16FE8 the helper requires normalized index one. The unsigned halfword at 0x830E8FE2 must differ from two, and signed word 0x82F700AC must be positive before the loop enters.
staticBranch.loop: The branch iterates player index i from zero while i is less than the reloaded positive signed bound at 0x82F700AC. The source-city signed owner byte, retained in r21, is player p.
staticBranch.filters: It skips i when signed halfword 0x830E9070 + 2*i equals that for p, when i equals the excluded-player word at 0x82F700B0, or when word 0x830ED2D8 + 4*(8*p+i) is nonzero.
staticBranch.writes: For a passing i, 0x82D17078 and 0x82D1707C store the same value, word 0x8312B8DC minus ten, to 0x830ED1D8 + 4*(8*i+p) and 0x830ED1D8 + 4*(8*p+i). The branch then continues the loop; it makes no direct diplomacy API call in this bounded window.
staticBranch.qualification: The symmetric writes supply an elapsed-value condition for a derived diplomacy-contact reader, under the conditions recorded for that reader. Other halfword and pair-field meanings, completed diplomatic actions, retention of the actual cells and runtime behavior remain unproved. The indexing scale does not establish the number of valid players.
staticBranch.clockInput: Native instructions D16C40/D16C4C load r31 from 8312B8DC. The selected index 1 path to D16FE8 bypasses the index 2/11/27 bodies without a call or r31 write; D17074 computes r31-10. ai-options-boundaries.json#/findings/RVA-F-0330/strategyDecisionBoundary owns the exact source, read and retention evidence and the derived reader.

runtimeObservation.result: The earlier fresh-game probe did not observe item-201 completion or the pair-table branch.

currentEvidence.method: A narrow generated-code window localized the index-one loop and symmetric stores. One foreground read-only canonical-project word window checked the entire local branch in the current image.

entries.result: Index one, halfword unequal to two, and positive signed loop bound gate the branch.
Halfword grouping, excluded player, and neutral pair-table word filter i before two symmetric stores of the same neutral-derived value.

currentEvidence.qualification: The post-threshold helper decompiler truncates at save thunks. The exact current-image words and narrow generated-code window support the local dataflow; no runtime probe was performed.

guards: Do not call either pair-table write a peace offer or treaty without its consumer.
Use the exact 8312B8DC source load and the linked reader's evidence. Minus-ten arithmetic alone does not establish a diplomatic deadline or completed action.
Do not infer a fixed valid player count from the eight-wide pair-table index.
Do not claim the stored description proves runtime activation or diplomatic outcome.
RVA-F-0177.conclusion: The direct Great Wall branch for item 201 can set symmetric civilization-pair entries to the captured 8312B8DC word minus 10 after its local filters. ai-options-boundaries.json#/findings/RVA-F-0330/strategyDecisionBoundary establishes a conditional derived diplomacy-contact reader. Actual peace offers, treaties and runtime activation remain unproved.
